capabilities: Count words, characters, pages, links, footnotes and other metrics in the status bar or sidebar tab
Create, duplicate and cycle between multiple word-count presets
Set limit warnings and goals with configurable progress indicators per metric
Fine-tune how formatting elements like links, comments and HTML tags are counted
Install community extensions (presets, metrics, advanced settings) from a built-in store
extras: The manifest notes that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation via BRAT is documented for beta versions, and drag-and-drop reordering on mobile is described as experimental.
intentEvidence: Create complex word count presets that will be displayed in the status bar or in the right pane tab.
motivation: The author, a scholar and teacher, built it because it helps in his research and he uses it in his teaching.
problem: Obsidian's built-in word count shows only basic words and characters, with no other metrics, no customization of what gets counted, and no sidebar view.

relations.evidence: If you want to test beta-versions of the plugin or use previous versions, you can do that with BRAT plugin
The extension provides support for the “Publish to Telegram” plugin emojis.

summary: Word-count plugin that tracks many metrics in the status bar or a sidebar tab, with presets, limit warnings, goals and a community extension store.
